text: At the Swansea Town Hall Association Annual General Meeting on May 16, 2018, the membership nominated the individuals listed above for appointment by Etobicoke York Community Council to the Board of Management of the Swansea Town Hall Community Centre. Appointments to the Swansea Town Hall Community Centre Board of Management is a matter for which the Community Council has been delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision, provided that the recommendations do not vary from the Public Appointments Policy. The date of original appointment and years of service that the Board Members who are recommended for reappointment, are as follows: Liz D’Andrea (May 2016, 2 years of service as of May 2018) Ruby Patrickson (April 2013, 5 years of service as of May 2018) Jaime Anderson (March 2014, 4 years of service as of May 2018) Tim Emo (March 2014, 4 years of service as of May…

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Appointed, at pleasure of Council, the following nominees, whose appointment complies with the Public Appointments Policy, to the Board of Management, Swansea Town Hall Community Centre, for a 2-year term ending on May 31, 2020, and until their successors are appointed: - Liz D’Andrea (recommended reappointment) - Ruby Patrickson (recommended reappointment) - Jaime Anderson (recommended reappointment) - Tim Emo (recommended reappointment) 2. Appointed, at the pleasure of Council, the following interest group nominee to the Board of Management, Swansea Town Hall Community Centre, for a two-year term of office ending on May 31, 2020, or until a successor is appointed: - Brenda Futz - Nominated by the Swansea Town Hall Residences replacing Thomas O’Reilly
